scope_note: This reports Freud's historical definition of the method's therapeutic role; it is not an efficacy finding and does not imply present-day diagnostic scope.
statement: In the same 1923 definition, Freud also used psychoanalysis for a treatment method for neurotic disorders based on that investigation.
statement_zh: 在同一份 1923 年定義中，Freud 也用精神分析指稱一種以該探究為基礎、用於神經症疾患的治療方法。
